sources.title: Construction begins at the Tenjincho data-centre site in Kodaira
sources.publisher: Hanako Times, reporting by Yoshihiro Kataoka
sources.source_family: Hanako Times, reporting by Yoshihiro Kataoka
sources.license: Publisher copyright. Selected factual observations with attribution.
sources.attribution: Hanako Times, reporting by Yoshihiro Kataoka
sources.summary: On October 22, 2026, the project representative confirmed to local residents that construction of the new data-centre building in Tenjincho had formally begun.

extraction.basis: The original local report quotes the project representative’s dated reply to the residents’ association. The author also reports active building work and the October 19 public building confirmation. The September 4 ceremony is a distinct earlier event.

firsthand_status_statement.speaker: Kodaira data-centre project team, in a written response to the local residents’ association
firsthand_status_statement.speaker_role: Project proponent, responding to an enquiry about the start of construction
firsthand_status_statement.project_identity: DayOne Kodaira Data Center, Tenjincho, Kodaira City
firsthand_status_statement.statement: The project team confirmed it had formally started new-building construction and that preparatory works continued in parallel.
firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: October 22 is the date of the project team’s reply. The local newspaper published the response on October 27.
firsthand_status_statement.review: The original report identifies the recipient as the association chaired by Yumiko Takezawa and reproduces the project team’s direct statement. The story specifically describes the DayOne Tenjincho construction site. It distinguishes confirmation of building works from preparatory activity and from the September groundbreaking ceremony.
